;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019 Cairo bombing]]
**A car drives into three other cars causing an explosive crash outside the [[National Cancer Institute Egypt]] campus in central [[Cairo]], killing 20 people and injuring 47 others. The [[Ministry of Interior (Egypt)|Interior Ministry]] says that the car that hit the others contained explosives and was to be used in a [[terrorism in Egypt|terrorist]] operation. The driver fled the scene before the explosion. The minister accuses the [[Islamic terrorism|Islamist]] [[Hasm Movement]] of being behind the attack. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-egypt-security-blast/seventeen-dead-in-car-explosion-in-central-cairo-health-ministry-idUSKCN1UV00G?il=0 (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[Iran–Iraq relations]]
**[[Iran]] seizes a foreign tanker, reported to be [[Iraq]]i, in the [[Persian Gulf]], according to Iranian state media. The [[Iran|Iranians]] accuse the tanker of "smuggling fuel for some [[Arab states of the Persian Gulf|Arab countries]]". [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-49225916 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[2019 Dayton shooting]]
**A [[mass shooting]] occurs at a bar in the [[Oregon Historic District]] of [[Dayton, Ohio]], [[United States]]. Nine people are killed and at least 27 others are injured. The shooter Connor Betts is killed by police. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-49224816 (BBC News)]

;Science and technology
*[[French people|French]] inventor [[Franky Zapata]] successfully crosses the [[English Channel]] on the jet-powered [[Flyboard Air]]. The 22-mile (35.4-km) journey took 22 minutes with one refueling stop about halfway to [[Dover]], England. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-49225001 (BBC News)] [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2019/aug/04/franky-zapata-crosses-channel-by-hoverboard-at-second-attempt (''The Guardian'')]

;Sports
* [[2019 Women's British Open]]
** In [[golf]], [[Japan]]'s [[Hinako Shibuno]] wins the year's final [[Women's major golf championships|major championship]] by one shot over [[United States|American]] [[Lizette Salas]]. Shibuno, a 20-year-old rookie on the [[Japan LPGA Tour]], was playing outside her home country for the first time, and was also playing for the first time in a major recognized by the [[LPGA|U.S. LPGA]]. [https://www.espn.com/golf/story/_/id/27321973/shibuno-wins-women-british-open-debut (AP via ESPN)]
